I just wish it wasn't tied to your FPS. It sucks turning while at anything below 90 fps.

Turning should be analogue. At the moment, it is digital. Frankly, smooth turning makes me nauseous, and only in this game, because of how poorly it's implemented. Speed should definitely be an option, but it should also be unbound from the frame rate too.

Please allow the mouse sensitivity slider to scale the turn speed when in VR. It's great that with the 2017 update turn speed is no longer tied to fps but because what's comfortable for turning in vr is so personal it seems necessary to have this customization. Using the existing mouse sensitivity slider shouldn't require any UI rework.

details:
Ever since i started playing the game with Comfort Turning off a big issue I've had is how slow turning in VRChat is. For someone with an Oculus and no 360° tracking, having the option to increase the turning speed would be very useful and less frustrating than having to stare in front of you while you're waiting for your character to spin to the person behind you.

Difficulties start to occur especially when the game starts to lag (which as we know is not on rare occasions), and turning with the joysticks becomes almost impossible.

Being able to turn faster would also help reduce motion sickness (as I have observed in games like SkyrimVR), without having to use the snap turning mode that ruins immersion for the player.
title: Please add a "Turning Speed" slider to the settings for VR users
